title: Incident snapshot — collapsible panels proposal
content:
Goal: design a compact, scannable incident snapshot view for the Console that makes error triage faster for engineers and SREs. Focus on timeouts, 5xx responses, and model-level errors (OOM, decoding failures, invalid logits). The view should be lightweight (fast to open), keyboard friendly, and provide actionable quick-paths (re-run, switch model, escalate, open trace).

Notes-to-self / design constraints:
- Primary persona: platform engineer / on-call SRE doing quick triage; secondary persona: product engineer debugging a user-reported failure.
- Should open from many entry points: alert link, request search result, trace timeline, log lines.
- Keep initial payload small: fetch summary fields first, lazily fetch heavy artifacts (token heatmaps, full response bodies).
- Avoid duplicating existing Trace UI; this is a fast, focused snapshot for one incident/request.
- Permission gating: sensitive payloads masked if not in project scope; show redaction banner.

Proposed layout (collapsible panels):
[Top bar] single-row header with: request id | timestamp | route | status badge (timeout/5xx/model-error) | quick-actions (re-run, copy request, escalate)

Main body: vertical stack of collapsible panels (collapsed by default except Summary):
1) Summary (expanded by default)
  - Short error blurb (e.g., “Inference timeout after 4.0s — backend worker saturated”).
  - Probable cause ribbon (low-confidence estimates based on heuristics): CPU saturation / model runtime / network / bad prompt. (Small pill UI with % confidence; tooltip explains heuristics.)
  - Quick health check row: model variant, GPU type, host region, queue length at time, latency p50/p95 for route in last 5m.

2) Request payload (collapsed)
  - Request metadata (user id, api key id, tags).
  - Prompt snippet (first 1–2k chars) with TLDR auto-summarization if >1k chars.
  - Link to full payload in blob store (lazy fetch).

3) Response samples (collapsed)
  - If partial response available, show side-by-side: actual vs expected (expected from golden set or previous successful run if available).
  - When model returned decoder errors, highlight first invalid token position and raw error.

4) Infrastructure timeline (collapsed)
  - Mini sparkline timeline showing CPU/GPU utilization for the node (10s resolution around event).
  - Network latency spikes and queue depth overlay.
  - Click expands to load full SRE timeline view.

5) Trace links & logs (collapsed)
  - Links to full trace view, span ids, and the log line that triggered the alert.

6) Reproduction & Quick fixes (collapsed)
  - Small inline sandbox: run a replay with editable parameters (model, max_tokens, timeout). Default pre-filled with original request.
  - Quick actions: retry same route, switch to fallback model (dropdown), throttle tokens, run with quantized variant. Each action logs an audit record and shows before/after diff of cost estimate.

7) Root-cause hints (collapsed)
  - Heuristic bullets e.g., "High queue length + p95 token time -> backpressure". Items link back to telemetry queries.

Interaction details / microcopy:
- Keyboard: press R to open Reproduction panel, C to copy request id, F to open full trace. Tooltips on badges show last 3 related incidents.
- State: panels remember user open/close per-session (local storage).
- Errors masked: if request contains PII, show masked prompt snippet and button "View (audit)" which opens sponsor-approved payload view.

Wireframe notes (visual priorities):
- Compact header, dense rows. The snapshot is not a full debugger but must be scannable in <7s.
- Use color-coded badges: red (5xx), orange (timeout), purple (model error). Badges have accessible labels "High priority" etc.
- Panels use low-contrast separators, slight elevation for Summary.

Backlog / grooming items (candidate tickets):
- PROD-UX-101: Basic snapshot frame + header + Summary panel (MVP). Estimate: 3 pts. Owner: Riley. Acceptance: open from alert -> shows header + summary + basic quick-actions.
- PROD-UX-102: Request payload panel + prompt snippeting + TLDR summarizer. Estimate: 5 pts. Owner: Samir. Acceptance: prompt >1k truncated w/ TLDR and link to blob.
- PROD-UX-103: Reproduction sandbox (server-side replay) + quick-actions. Estimate: 8 pts. Owner: Jules. Security review required. Acceptance: user can run replay and see result in inline panel.
- PROD-UX-104: Heuristic RCA ribbon (probability score). Estimate: 5 pts. Owner: Avery. Acceptance: Ribbon appears with at least 3 heuristic rules and tooltip linking to the rule definition.
- PROD-UX-105: Telemetry mini-timeline and expand-to-trace. Estimate: 5 pts. Owner: SRE lead. Acceptance: sparkline shows util and queue data for 1m window.

Open questions / risks:
- How to surface confidence for heuristic RCA without being misleading? Need input from applied-ML on model error classification.
- Security: replay could leak secrets if not sandboxed; add enforcement to strip api key headers.
- Performance: ensure snapshot API is <200ms for summary payload to keep it snappy. We may need a denormalized incident snapshot store.

Design alternatives considered (brief):
- Modal vs. full-page: modal felt lighter but has limited space for timeline; decided on side-drawer style if opened from trace, full page if opened from alert landing.
- Single long scroll vs collapsible panels: chose collapsibles to reduce cognitive load and network fetch.

Acceptance criteria for MVP:
- Snapshot can be opened from alert link and request list in under 300ms (summary data).
- Summary panel contains error blurb, probable cause ribbon, and 3 quick-actions (retry, copy id, open trace).
- Reproduction sandbox is stubbed (runs in async mode and returns a simulated response).
- All UI elements pass basic accessibility checks (keyboard focus, labels).

Notes for follow-ups:
- Add session-based heatmaps showing token decode hot-spots (later).
- Integrate with Optimize causal analysis to detect regressions across model rollouts.
- Add team-specific saved queries (pin RCA filters).

Slack thread refs: #console-ux, #sre-ops; ping Riley/Samir/Jules for next design sync.

Choppy TODO list for next meeting:
- [ ] finalize heuristics with applied-ml (Avery)
- [ ] infra impact estimate for snapshot store (SRE)
- [ ] API contract for replay (backend)
- [ ] security review for replay feature (security)
- [ ] prototype keyboard shortcuts (frontend)

End of draft — this is intentionally informal, will iterate after design sync.
